name: Bonemeal More
summary: Use bone meal on sugar cane, cactus and nether wart to grow them a block or a stage at a time, by hand or from a dispenser.
logoPrompt: A single tall green sugar cane stalk with a small white pile of bone meal at its base and a few green sparkles around it

cover.tagline: Bone meal for cane, cactus and wart.
bullets: One block or stage per use

description: **Bonemeal More lets bone meal grow the three plants it never worked on: sugar cane, cactus and nether wart.**
- Sugar cane and cactus grow by one block on top per use, up to their natural height of three blocks.
- Nether wart moves on by one of its four stages, so fresh wart is ripe after three uses.
- No bone meal is lost: full columns, ripe wart, a block above the top or a cactus that would touch a block take none.
- Dispensers filled with bone meal grow all three plants as well.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Right-click any block of a sugar cane or cactus column, or a nether wart, with bone meal in your main hand.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players without the mod see the plant grow but not the green sparkles.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
